featured_reviews.name: Mayur
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re a milkshake lover, The Juice Farm is definitely a spot worth visiting. This small and vibrant outlet offers a variety of fresh juices and rich milkshakes that are perfect for a quick refreshing break.

During our visit, we tried the Chikoo Milkshake Mastani and Custard Apple Mastani, and both were absolutely delicious. The chikoo mastani was thick, creamy, and naturally sweet with the perfect balance of flavor. The custard apple mastani stood out with its rich texture and authentic fruit taste, making it a delightful treat for anyone who enjoys seasonal fruit-based shakes.

The place has a casual and welcoming vibe, making it a nice stop to cool down and enjoy something sweet and refreshing. Overall, it’s a great place in Goregaon West to satisfy your milkshake cravings. Highly recommended if you’re in the area and looking for tasty, refreshing drinks! 🥤✨

featured_reviews.name: Pranjal T
featured_reviews.review_text: Tried their guava juice, guava chilli, and orange juice — and honestly, every sip delivered. Fresh flavours, great balance, and clearly good-quality ingredients. Prices are reasonable, which makes it even better. I couldn’t fully see the kitchen area, but overall the place felt hygienic. If you enjoy fresh juices done right, this spot is definitely worth trying. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: TheRikinhemani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was served a stale jamun juice, and what disappointed me even more was the way the situation was handled.

When we approached the lady at the counter and informed her that the juice had a stale smell, she flatly refused to acknowledge it. Fortunately, another customer at a nearby table confirmed that the drink did indeed smell stale, yet she still refused to accept that a bad product had been served.

In the end, I left the juice at the counter without asking for a refund or even a replacement because of the way I was treated.

I had been a regular customer and expected much better service and basic courtesy. Instead of addressing a genuine concern, the staff chose to deny the issue altogether. This experience has completely ruined my trust in the place, and I will not be visiting again.

featured_reviews.name: Savita Rajesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
First time Ordered two mosambi juices and one mango through zomato. Order was delivered quickly probably as we stay nearby.
All three  juices had a weird  after taste so I don't know if it was due to the ice or water quality used or if the reason was the plastic container.
Request the shop to check into this.

featured_reviews.name: Shahbaz Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently tried the Mango Mastani at The Juice Farm, and it was an absolute delight! The drink perfectly balances the rich, creamy texture with the natural sweetness of ripe mangoes. The freshness of the fruit really shines through, making every sip refreshing and indulgent.
The presentation was vibrant and inviting, topped with dry fruits and ice cream that added a luxurious touch. It felt less like a simple juice and more like a festive treat. The portion size was generous, and the flavors lingered pleasantly without being overly sweet.
Overall, Mango Mastani from The Juice Farm is a must-try for anyone who loves mangoes.

featured_reviews.name: prajyot hirugade
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited The juice farm , and I must say, it was a fantastic experience! The variety of fresh juices, smoothies, and shakes available was impressive. They use high-quality, fresh fruits, and you can truly taste the difference in every sip.

The ambiance was clean and inviting, making it a great place to relax and enjoy a healthy drink. The staff was friendly and prepared our order quickly, which was a plus. I especially loved their [mention a specific juice or smoothie you liked], which was perfectly balanced in flavor and freshness.

The prices are reasonable for the quality offered, and they even have options for customization based on preferences like less sugar or dairy-free alternatives.

Overall, I highly recommend [Juice Centre Name] to anyone looking for a refreshing and nutritious drink. I’ll definitely be coming back!

featured_reviews.name: Yaseen Sayyed
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ordered a strawberry milkshake. The staff kept forcing a strawberry mastani even after I denied. The milkshake took 10 minutes and tasted terrible, clearly not made from fresh strawberries.
When I politely asked the person in charge about it, he was rude and showed no concern. I paid and left the drink on the counter. No apology, no replacement, no courtesy. Later, the staff threw the drink in the dustbin, which said everything.
Poor quality, unprofessional staff, and zero customer service. Would not recommend.

featured_reviews.name: Sakina Gadiwala
featured_reviews.review_text: Best place for healthy and fresh juices. Their orange juice was exceptionally yumm, and Aamras tasted very pure. Do visit and must try their Mastani

featured_reviews.name: Shayan Zaidi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently tried their food and had a really great experience. The fries were perfectly cooked – crispy on the outside yet juicy and flavorful inside. The cheese balls were another highlight; they were rich, gooey, and absolutely delicious. I also tried their pizza combo, and it turned out to be the star of the meal. The pizza was fresh, well-topped, and full of flavor, making the combo a great value overall.

The portion sizes were satisfying, and the quality of ingredients was clearly noticeable. If you’re looking for a place that serves tasty snacks along with a fulfilling pizza option, this is definitely worth checking out. I would highly recommend trying their pizza combo along with the sides for a complete experience.

featured_reviews.name: DARSHAN MALAVIYA
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sudama Snacks & Juices is a perfect place for variety lovers. Their pav bhaji is rich, buttery, and full of flavor with nicely toasted pav. The dosa is crispy and well-cooked, served with tasty chutney and sambhar. They also offer Chinese items which are quite good—noodles and fried rice are flavorful and satisfying.

Along with this, their fresh juices are refreshing and a must-try. Service is quick, prices are reasonable, and the place is great for a casual snack outing.

Overall, a nice spot for enjoying different cuisines at one place 👍

featured_reviews.name: Krunal Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text: Very disappointed with the juice served at Sudama Pure Veg. We ordered it for our child, expecting it to be fresh and of good quality, but it was not. The juice tasted diluted and did not seem fresh. What made the experience worse was that when we raised the issue and requested a replacement, the owner argued with us instead of addressing the complaint professionally and finding a solution. Good customer service is just as important as food quality, and unfortunately both were lacking during our visit. This was a disappointing experience and not worth the money. I hope the management takes customer feedback seriously and improves both quality control and customer service.

featured_reviews.name: Sushmita Mohite
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Sudama, a restaurant located just 10 minutes walking distance from Goregaon West Station, along with my sisters. I had fond memories of this place from 5-6 years ago, particularly for their Punjabi dishes. However, this visit left me with mixed feelings.
The menu seems to have shifted focus from serving traditional Punjabi dishes to offering mainly snacks and Chinese cuisine. Despite this, the quality of food remains impressive. We ordered Veg Crispy, Pizza, and Triple Fried Rice, and each dish was flavorful and well-prepared.
While the food was quite satisfying, the service left something to be desired. Although the staff was efficient, it felt like they were rushing us, almost like they wanted to finish quickly . This took away from what could have been a more relaxed dining experience.
Overall, Sudama is still a good choice if you’re looking for tasty food at a pocket-friendly price. Just be prepared for a slightly hurried pace of service.

Negative :-
No air conditioning

Had 1 pav bhaji 2 extra bread

1 paneer 65
1 mineral water

I think they should respect all those who enter their restaurant and take everyone’s opinion genuinely and should not think that ‘log toh aake kha rahe hain iss mein kya kharabi hain’ ‘tum bhi khao’ 😅
Not good experience sorry Sudama for my review and mind it it was Dhanteras 🪔

You'll enjoy here all types of dosas, sandwiches, misal pav and paav bhaji. featured_reviews.name: Bhavika Kaklotar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I strongly request everyone not to visit this place.

We ordered a fruit bowl costing around ₹300 for our 10-month-old baby, assuming that under a brand name, the quality would be good and premium. Unfortunately, this assumption turned out to be completely false.

I clearly requested their staff not to add any tangy fruits, yet they still added orange, which was extremely sour—so much so that even adults could not eat it.

The rest of the fruits, including apple and papaya, were in very poor condition and not fresh at all.

Overall, the fruit quality was extremely low—worse than what is usually offered by street vendors. This was a very disappointing and unacceptable experience, especially when it involved food for an infant.

featured_reviews.name: Andy B
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located at top level of Oberio Mall sandwiched between Burger King & Taco Bell, it is a small outlets but commands it's own patron.

The selling point is health. But don't be surprised if you don't get your desired drink. This is what happened to us. We wanted avocado juice, but to our dismay there weren't any. Neither were there any notification that specific drinks are not available.

We settled for grapes and berry juice. For the taste, we think there were added sugar to enhance the taste. But good enough. They ask you beforehand if you want ice added or not. Stick to seasonal fruits & vegetables.

Experience: A very disinterested person took our order with short responses. It took about 3 to 5 min on a weekday for my order. Straws provided are sealed (+ point). They accept cash, paytm and cards.
